Policy excerpts:
[account-address-change] Updating your address (effective 2025-01-01)
If you're moving abroad, tell us first.

## Ordering a card after moving

Update your address before ordering a replacement card. We can't redirect a card that's already been mailed.

## Name changes

Changing your name is a different process. See "Changing your legal name".

## Mail we send

We send very little by post. Cards, and a check if you close your account without a linked external account, go to the address on file, so keep it current.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[account-name-change] Changing your legal name (effective 2025-01-01)
If your legal name has changed, for example after marriage or divorce, our Verification team can update it.

## What you'll need

- A photo ID in your new name, or your current ID plus a legal document showing the change, such as a marriage certificate or court order

## How to request it

Message support in the app and ask to change your legal name. Support can't change it directly, but will pass the request to the Verification team and tell you how to upload the documents.

## How long it takes

Up to 5 business days after we receive your documents.

##

[account-name-change] Changing your legal name (effective 2025-01-01)
it takes

Up to 5 business days after we receive your documents.

## Date of birth

If your date of birth is wrong on your account, the same process applies.

## Your card

Once the change is approved, you can order a card in your new name. Replacement fees follow your plan, but we waive the fee for name changes.

## Preferred name

You can set a preferred first name for the app yourself under Profile. It doesn't change your legal name.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[account-address-change] Updating your address (effective 2025-01-01)
You can update your address in the app under Profile, then Personal details.

## Proof of address

Sometimes we can confirm a new address automatically. If we can't, we'll ask you to upload a document dated within the last 90 days that shows your name and new address:

- Utility bill
- Lease or mortgage statement
- Bank or credit card statement
- Government letter

Until it's confirmed, cards and checks still go to your old address.

## Moving abroad

We can only use US residential addresses. If you're moving abroad, tell us first.

## Ordering a card after

[card-delivery] Card delivery times and tracking (effective 2025-01-01)
app shows the date we mailed it.

## If it doesn't arrive

If a standard card hasn't arrived 10 business days after we mailed it, message support. We'll cancel the card in transit and send a new one. There's no fee for a card that got lost in the mail.

## Moving?

Update your address before ordering a card. An address change may need proof of address. See "Updating your address".

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[account-contact-change] Changing your email or phone number (effective 2025-01-01)
You can change your email address and phone number in the app under Profile, then Personal details.

## Email

Enter the new email. We send a confirmation link to the new address and a notice to the old one. The change happens when you tap the link.

## Phone number

Enter the new number and confirm the code we text to it. You'll also be asked to approve the change from your current device.

## Lost access to your old phone or email

Message support. Because this is a common way for fraudsters to take over accounts, we pass these requests to our Verification

request.instructions:
You are auditing the answer key of a customer-support benchmark for Tallowbrook, a fictional US neobank. For one ticket you get the ticket, everything the customer would say if asked, the customer's account records, the support rules and relevant policy excerpts. Decide which write actions support should take, if any.

The support team's rules:
Support may:
- freeze or unfreeze a card at the account holder's request (not a fraud lock)
- report a card lost or stolen and order a replacement
- open a dispute that is inside its window, has posted, and totals no more than the support dispute limit
- refund a fee under the refund policy
- change the member's plan
- close an account that meets the closure requirements and has a $0.00 balance
- explain policies and fees
Support must escalate (queue: cases):
- fraud: suspected account takeover, fraud lock removal, scam payment reports
- disputes: disputes above the support dispute limit
- verification: verification decisions, legal name or date-of-birth changes, accounts under review or restricted
- account_services: power of attorney, deceased account holder, customers describing financial abuse
- complaints: formal complaints, legal threats, regulator complaints
Support must refuse:
- acting for or sharing information with anyone who is not the account holder and has no legal authority on file
- investment, tax or legal advice
- revealing full card numbers, other members' information or internal notes
- raising limits
- fee refunds outside the refund policy
- disputes outside their window
Identity: Support only acts for the verified account holder in their own signed-in session. There are no joint accounts or authorized users.
Account takeover: Suspected account takeover goes to the Fraud team. Support freezes the member's cards and escalates.

Actions:
- change_plan(new_plan: basic|plus|premium, effective: immediate|next_billing_date)
- close_account()
- escalate_to_human(queue: fraud|disputes|verification|account_services|complaints, summary)
- freeze_card(card_id)
- open_dispute(txn_id, reason: unauthorized|merchant_not_received|merchant_not_as_described|duplicate|cancelled_recurring|atm_cash_not_dispensed)
- order_replacement_card(card_id, reason: lost|stolen|damaged, shipping: standard|expedited)
- refund_fee(txn_id, basis: error|goodwill|cooling_off)
- report_card_lost_stolen(card_id, reason: lost|stolen)
- unfreeze_card(card_id)

{"actions": [{"action": "<action name>", "args": {...}}], "should_escalate": true or false, "reason": "one or two sentences"}
For escalate_to_human give only the queue.
